name: Large sets avoiding x, 2x, 3x
description: construct() -> a nonempty subset of [1,n=4096] containing no triple {x,2x,3x}. Maximize cardinality; density is recorded as an exact fraction. Maximize the size of a subset of [1,4096] avoiding {x,2x,3x}. This yields a finite construction, not the exact limiting density or its irrationality. The optimum is 3281, computed exactly on the independent 3-smooth grids (OEIS A157282); this is a rediscovery task.

state_of_the_art.statement: The maximum is 3281 (density 3281/4096). The problem splits into independent grids {2^a 3^b m : gcd(m,6) = 1} (the decomposition behind OEIS A157282). An exact dynamic programme over every grid (scripts/check_state_of_the_art.py) gives 3281. The limiting density is Erdős Problem #168.
